rule: Column = edge-neighbour road mask (NE=1, SE=2, SW=4, NW=8). Row = corner (diagonal) neighbour road mask (N=1, E=2, S=4, W=8). Frame index = row*16+col. Mask 0/0 = lone dirt patch; a single bit = end cap.
note: Overlay drawn on plains after all ground tiles. Each piece draws its half of every link, so neighbours join seamlessly. Diagonal links pass through the shared tile corner and paint a few pixels into the two flanking tiles (inside this 32x16 frame), so draw overlays in a pass after the ground layer. Grid: SE = column+1, SW = row+1, N = (row-1,col-1), E = (row-1,col+1), S = (row+1,col+1), W = (row+1,col-1). Replaces road_nw_se (= col 10, row 0).
